text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the days of taking on the 
Twinkle Series with the "Empress," Air 
Groove, finally begin!

Ever since before her debut, her ability 
and aura have commanded immense 
expectations. As her Trainer, I cannot 
afford to provide half-hearted guidance.

First, we need to decide on our training 
policy leading up to her debut race. I 
immediately went to look for her—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Continuing from last month, the 
trash separation on campus is still not up 
to standard.

I spotted Air Groove, but she was deep in 
serious conversation with several 
students...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us raise the matter of 
waste sorting awareness in the student 
council agenda today.

It seems to be student council work. As 
the vice president, Air Groove must have 
her hands full with all sorts of things.
choice_data_list:
(I guess I shouldn't talk to them right 
now...)

text_block_list.name: Beautification Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I talked to you, Senpai... 
Thank you so much for listening!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This too is a natural duty of the student 
council. Please don't hesitate to consult 
me in the future.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Vice President Air Groove~! I need some 
advice~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Something else has come up, so I must 
take my leave. Thank you, as always, for 
your efforts in keeping the academy 
beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Beautification Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Senpai really is so wonderful~. 
Even though she's busy, she listened to my 
worries right away...

While her work for the student council is 
admirable as always, now is really not the 
time for that...!
choice_data_list: (I have to catch up to Air Groove...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—You may tear this poster down now. That 
will free up space to put up a new one."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, this club recruitment flyer 
isn't appropriate to post here. Please 
move it to the bulletin board by the 
entrance—

"I've been looking for a chance to consult 
Air Groove since this morning, but her 
work shows no sign of slowing down..."
choice_data_list:
(That said, I shouldn't get in the way of 
work...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, please proceed according to the 
instructions from here on. Report the 
status back to me tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then, next is...

If I'm going to call out to her, it has to 
be now! The moment that thought crossed my 
mind—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove. You're just in time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Before the regular afternoon meeting, 
there's something I wanted to confirm.

—Symboli Rudolf. Student Council President 
of Tracen Academy, and heralded as one of 
the strongest of all time.

Dominating all competition with 
overwhelming strength as she continues her 
imperial path, she has become an 
inspiration to countless Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look...! Student Council President 
Symboli Rudolf and Vice President Air 
Groove...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
When you two stand together, your aura is 
incredible~! So cool...♪

With Student Council President Symboli 
Rudolf's arrival, the crowd grows restless 
with excitement. There's no way I can talk 
to her like this...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It isn't urgent, so we can reschedule if 
needed, but how does your schedule look?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No problem at all. I just happened to 
be free at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now, let's change locations. 
Off to the student council room.

Air Groove departed the scene alongside 
Symboli Rudolf...
choice_data_list:
(I missed my chance to call out to her 
again...)

text_block_list.text:
In the end, training time arrived before I 
could speak directly with Air Groove...

At this rate, I'll just have to cut back 
on training time and discuss our plans 
moving forward. Just as I was thinking 
that—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—If there is something you wish to say, 
speak without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Surely, you weren't following me around 
without any particular purpose, were you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. When someone prowls around the edge 
of my vision like that, it's impossible 
not to notice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Most likely, you couldn't bring 
yourself to call out to me because I 
seemed busy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Underestimating me, are they?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the "Empress," neither Student Council 
duties nor daily training are ever 
neglected in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I always have enough leeway to 
hear out a consultation or two from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you are to be my Trainer, perform your 
duties with everything you have. You 
shouldn't have time for useless 
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And? What was it you intended to 
discuss with me today?

I was finally able to talk with Air Groove 
about the direction of our training policy 
leading up to her debut race...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I understand the general direction 
for now. Well, it shouldn't be too bad.
choice_data_list: Once again, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Allow me to say it once more as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am the "Empress." One who embodies the 
ideals of all Umamusume and exists to be a 
guiding light for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you are to serve as my trainer, always 
maintain an awareness of being watched.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Time is wasting. Let's get right to it.

Before I could even comprehend the meaning 
of her words, Air Groove began running 
onto the course.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

Air Groove worked through her training 
menu with fierce devotion. Her 
breathtaking focus left me in awe.

"...She's hard on herself too. As if to 
prove it, her sweat glinted in the light."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Air Groove-senpai is running!

Before we knew it, a crowd of spectators 
had gathered around Air Groove's training 
session.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Even though it's just training, 
her intensity is off the charts.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for the debut race! She's 
gonna look so totally cool...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, you're amazing... Even with all 
eyes on you, you stand so proud and 
dignified...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I need to learn from that too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. I can still keep going—"

Air Groove starts running again, watched 
closely by the other Umamusume.

Deep within their eyes, a new light seemed 
to have been kindled.
choice_data_list:
(Always being conscious of being watched, 
huh...)

text_block_list.text:
I resolved in my heart to tighten my 
discipline even further, so that I could 
stand beside her as her Trainer.

—And so began the days of challenging the 
limits with the "Empress," Air Groove!
